annotations.text:
ENTRY FLOW — light blue / green / white identity.
Archivo + IBM Plex Sans/Mono on white; blue consumption, green solar.

Landing: filter the capabilities by domain and persona, follow a proof chain, switch the pricing cycle.
Sign in: three auth methods, six roles, and a live preview of what each role's session can see.
Activation: three steps, manual entry or bill scan, real GERC plan prices.

CONSUMER APP (web) — under 5 minutes to subscribe, then everything is derived.
My energy, Bills (each line opens to the two register reads behind it), Analytics with a real filter rail, Plans, Support, Account settings, Notification centre, Carbon & solar impact.

MOBILE + PAYMENT + STATES.
Phone (390px): home, bill + pay, subscribe wizard, and meter self-read — photograph the meter, OCR reads the digits, low-confidence digits are outlined for the user to fix before submit (Torrent-style).
Payment wizard: method -> details -> OTP -> receipt, bank-hosted.
Five states: the same stat tile in loading / empty / partial / stale / error, because no component may outlive its data (DESIGN.md P2).

SOCIETY & DISCOM — modelled on the real Gujarat sector (UGVCL / MGVCL / DGVCL / PGVCL + Torrent + Adani).
Society: overview + units register + allocation editor (solar split pro-rata, sum always equals metered generation).
DISCOM: command centre, loss drill-down, net-metering queue vs the GERC 15-day SOP, new-connection approvals with the DT-capacity check, prepaid watch with the mandated 3-day grace, outage management, and the append-only hash-chained audit ledger.

OPERATOR · FIELD · SUPPORT.
Operator (RESCO): fleet portfolio, sites & devices with staged OTA + auto-rollback, generation vs the 95% guarantee, and an ESG report that states its coverage rather than presenting estimates as fact.
Field: work-order queue, meter-photo OCR with confidence gating, and an optimised route with the site-inspection checklist.
Support: SLA-aware queue, consumer 360, and a knowledge base whose canned responses auto-fill from the real record.

MARKETING & PLATFORM ADMIN.
Pricing: three tiers, cycle toggle, a full what's-included table, and the objections people actually raise.
How it works: four steps from 'check my roof' to live, and the system diagram of where EcoPower sits between the roof and the DISCOM grid.
Platform admin: tenants (the Gujarat utilities reference set), billing runs, device fleet and system health.
